subject: Post-demo follow-up: procurement pathway & budget owner confirmation
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: procurement pathway & budget owner confirmation

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time to demo yesterday. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned with your procurement rhythm: 

- What we saw: Redwood inference platform for low-latency, cost-optimized LLM inference across hosted and private deployments.
- Business fit: You mentioned two pilot use cases (clinical note summarization, patient triage reranking) that map to our standard Healthcare pricing and a likely 6–9 month procurement window.

As we discussed, to keep momentum it would be helpful to confirm two items so we can tailor the MAP and pricing: 
1) Economic/budget owner for the pilot (who signs off on the spend?)
2) Procurement/legal contacts and expected steps (NDA → security questionnaire → PO? any internal templates?)

I’ve attached a short procurement checklist that outlines what we typically need and suggested timing. Can you confirm the budget owner and introduce the procurement contact? If helpful I can draft a one-page overview for Michael (or the person you indicate) to expedite internal approval.

Proposed next step: 30-minute intro with procurement + budget owner next week. I’ve penciled in Tue/Wed afternoon as options but will wait for your availability.

Thanks — look forward to the intro.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: procurement_checklist.pdf

From: Sophie Turner <sophie@clearviewhealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T16:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: procurement pathway & budget owner confirmation

Rachel —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers: 

- Economic/budget owner: Michael Alvarez, VP Finance (michael.alvarez@clearviewhealth.com). He typically signs off on piloting vendor spend up to $150k.
- Procurement contact: procurement@clearviewhealth.com (I’ve copied the team on a separate internal note).
- Legal/security: our legal team will expect an initial security questionnaire and NDA. They prefer vendor questionnaires completed in our doc template (I’ll attach it in the thread if you need).

I’ve attached our SOW requirements spreadsheet that outlines data isolation and delivery milestones — it will help you prepare the MAP. Happy to join the intro call.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Director, Digital Transformation | ClearView Health
Attachment: SOW_requirements.xlsx

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo follow-up: procurement pathway & budget owner confirmation

Markus / Ben / Laura — FYI, Sophie confirmed Michael Alvarez (VP Finance) as the econ/budget owner and procurement@clearviewhealth.com as the procurement contact. She attached their SOW requirements.

Action items I propose: 
- Ben: can you lead outreach to Michael and procurement to schedule the intro (you’ll drive the MAP)? Use the attached procurement checklist + our pricing snapshot.
- Markus: can you advise on discount bands and any exec escalation we should plan for if the spend is near/above $100k?
- Laura: heads-up on security questionnaire — they said legal prefers their template. I’ll forward the questionnaire as soon as they send it; likely we’ll need to scope our SOC2 excerpt and data flow diagram.

I’ll draft a one-pager for Michael and send it to everyone for a quick sign-off before outreach.

Thanks —
Rachel

Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo follow-up: procurement pathway & budget owner confirmation

Perfect — I’ll take point. Proposed immediate plan: 

1) Send a concise intro email to Michael & procurement with the one-pager + MAP draft (goal: secure a 30-min intro).
2) Attach pricing_snapshot.pdf and a clearly labeled appendix that shows pilot pricing bands (monthly token tiers).
3) Flag security questionnaire to Laura and request the SOC2 docs and data-flow diagram.

I’ve attached the first-draft MAP and pricing snapshot for review — Rachel, if you can approve the one-pager I’ll send the outreach this afternoon. Markus — note the pricing bands; recommend we hold 12% discount for pilots <$100k and 8% for $100–150k.

—Ben
Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.docx; pricing_snapshot.pdf

Thanks, all. Adding procurement and Michael on this thread. Our preferred intake steps are: NDA → security questionnaire → SOW and PO. I’m available for the intro call on Tue 4/27 2:00–3:30pm ET or Wed 4/28 11:00–12:00pm ET. 

Procurement (copied) — please propose an initial 30-minute slot next week and let us know if you need any additional vendor documents. I’ve uploaded the SOW requirements to the shared drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink

Looking forward to the intro.

Best,
Sophie
